query:
SELECT r.id as residentId, r.firstName, r.lastName, p.id as packageId, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.endDate, p.isActive
FROM residents r
JOIN packages p ON r.id = p.residentId
WHERE r.firstName = 'Nicolas' AND r.lastName = 'Klein'
ORDER BY p.id DESC
LIMIT 1;
